businesses.name: JesusIsMyReligion
businesses.description: Jesus is the word made flesh (John 1:14), so we are going to do everything we can to spread Jesus Christ and His Gospel of the Kingdom come. Ten percent (10%) of every sale goes to spreading the Gospel throughout the world. If you spend $30… $3 goes out. If you spend $300… $30 goes out. Let's spread Jesus together!

businesses.name: Logo Connection
businesses.description: Logo Connection is a single source for silkscreen, embroidery, print, signage and promotional products, all held to the same quality and standard so that your company or brand always looks consistently great. We focus on the little details to ensure every order is done to spec and on schedule. We forward the Gospel by partnering with selected non-profit organizations and Christ-based companies to make Jesus known.
